questions.question: Whose offering did Jesus say was greater than all the others at the treasury?
What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?
options: It would stand unshaken for all time
It would be made far greater than before
Not one stone would be left on another
It would be rebuilt in three short days
questions.answer: Not one stone would be left on another
